body.en:
Question B-005-007-008.

Why the correct answer is right: Hertz means cycles per second. A frequency of 60 Hz means the waveform completes 60 cycles in one second.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "6000 metres per second": Metres per second is speed, not frequency, and 60 Hz does not mean 6000 of anything.
- sourceIndex 2: "60 metres per second": This uses the correct number but the wrong unit; hertz counts cycles per second.
- sourceIndex 3: "6000 cycles per second": This uses the right kind of unit but moves the decimal by a factor of 100. Sixty hertz is 60 cycles per second.
